verdict.rationale: Requesty documents its own 'auto caching' feature, which caches long system prompts and repeated content to cut cost by up to 90%, and cache savings appear in its analytics. However, this is provider-side prompt caching that only works on providers supporting it. It is not a gateway-level response cache that returns stored completions for repeated requests. missing for 10: true gateway-side response caching independent of provider, documented latency reduction on cache hits, cache controls (TTL/keys/invalidation), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache responses at the gateway to cut cost and latency on repeated requests

citations.quote: Requesty's auto caching automatically caches long system prompts and repeated content to reduce costs on any provider that supports prompt caching.
Reduce costs by up to 90% with automatic prompt caching. Works with any provider that supports prompt caching, on both Chat Completions and Responses APIs
Track costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency, all in real-time.
